description: Source file implementing HTTP/2 frame structures and related operators for the Chromium project, including classes like Http2FrameHeader, Http2PriorityFields, Http2RstStreamFields, etc.

classes.name: Http2FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of an HTTP/2 frame, with methods for string conversion and response detection.

classes.name: Http2PriorityFields
classes.description: Represents priority-related fields in HTTP/2, including stream dependency and weight.

classes.name: Http2RstStreamFields
classes.description: Represents RST_STREAM frame fields, primarily error code.

classes.name: Http2SettingFields
classes.description: Represents SETTINGS frame fields, including parameter and value.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseFields
classes.description: Represents PUSH_PROMISE frame fields, specifically the promised stream ID.

classes.name: Http2PingFields
classes.description: Represents PING frame fields, specifically opaque bytes.

classes.name: Http2GoAwayFields
classes.description: Represents GOAWAY frame fields, including last stream ID and error code.

classes.name: Http2WindowUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents WINDOW_UPDATE frame fields, specifically window size increment.

classes.name: Http2AltSvcFields
classes.description: Represents ALTSVC frame fields, specifically origin length.

classes.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents PRIORITY_UPDATE frame fields, specifically the prioritized stream ID.

methods.name: IsProbableHttpResponse
methods.description: Determines if the frame header likely corresponds to an HTTP response based on payload length, type, and flags.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the frame header or fields to a human-readable string.

methods.name: FlagsToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the frame flags.

methods.name: Http2PriorityFields::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the priority fields.

methods.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the prioritized stream ID.
